audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with the page's own why-strings: Skill at level 1 where whys[0] says 'You win Level 1', Yorick at 2 and 3 where whys[1] and whys[2] say skill/even, Skill at 4-5 and 6 where whys[3] and whys[4] say your ghouls and Maiden take over, and Yorick at 2+ items where whys[6] says late 'evens the 5v5'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Skill — identical to those whys row for row. Two independent sources against the sides layer. NOTE: the mirror settled the opposite, see notes.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side to Yorick (6/10), win[1] and win[2] to Skill, win[3] and win[4] to Yorick (7/10 each), win[6] to Skill, each in matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..2] and phases[6] why-strings were generic boilerplate and, after the rows moved, three of them named the wrong owner.
audit.why: Maokai's spikes are Twisted Advance at 14s (untargetable during the dash) and Nature's Grasp at 130s, which is a teamfight wall rather than a duel button — that is why level 6 belongs to Yorick and the last row is a wash. Yorick's are Last Rites healing at level 1 and Maiden at 6.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0].why, phases[1].why, phases[2].why and phases[6].why to those spikes with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect — the page names only Twisted Advance and never Sap Magic, Bramble Smash, Sapling Toss or Nature's Grasp, and gives no cooldowns.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 at 525 range and makes him UNTARGETABLE while he dashes, so burst timed onto the cast is wasted — that is the interaction the page needed and did not have. Bramble Smash is 7s at rank 1 and knocks back plus slows. Sapling Toss is 1100 range on 18s and is stronger in brush, which is the real reason not to fight in bushes here. Nature's Grasp is 130s at rank 1 with 3000 range.
audit.corrected: All named with cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'his healing fights your pattern' without naming the source.
audit.why: Sap Magic heals him on a basic attack and its cooldown drops every time he casts a spell or is hit by one — so in an extended trade against a swarm it comes back fast, which is exactly when Grievous Wounds pays.
audit.corrected: Named Sap Magic and its cooldown reduction in the itemization line.

edits.before: You have nothing yet — just bank graves off the wave. Identify how Maokai contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Last Rites resets your attack and heals you, and his Sap Magic heal is on a cooldown — the level 1 trade is yours to take.

edits.before: E mark plus the first ghoul wave starts real trades. Only take the trade when Maokai's Twisted Advance is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and makes him untargetable as he dashes — trade only after he spends it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Maokai must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Even: Bramble Smash knocks back and slows on 7s, so his poke answers your first ghouls until you bank graves.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Maokai carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your split and his teamfight CC cancel out — Nature's Grasp is a 130s wall of roots that decides 5v5s, not duels.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — His lock-on root. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twisted Advance: 14s at rank 1, 525 range — he is untargetable during the dash, so burst before it, not into it. - Bramble Smash: 7s at rank 1, knocks back and slows. - Nature's Grasp: 130s at rank 1, 3000 range.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 — commit into its downtime.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Sapling Toss is 1100 range on 18s and is stronger in brush.

edits.before: Track Maokai's Twisted Advance (Root): His lock-on root. Dodge it. When it is down — Cage + swarm him.
edits.after: Twisted Advance: 14s at rank 1, and he is untargetable mid-dash — time your burst before it, never into it.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Trinity Force  (the all-purpose spike), then Hullbreaker; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Trinity Force (the all-purpose spike), then Hullbreaker; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling — Sap Magic heals him and every spell shortens it.
